summary: CertificationEditAll is a user control for managing and editing student certification records in the context of enrollment. It provides a grid interface for bulk editing, updating, and maintaining certifications, supporting complex filtering, workflow commands, and field-level validation. The control integrates with session state, performs updates via backend services, and dynamically adjusts UI elements based on context (such as read-only mode and number of rows).
purpose: Enable administrators or authorized users to view, edit, and bulk update student certification details for a selected cohort, course, and term. Handles the certification workflow during enrollment processing, including status changes, date validation, and navigation between records.

workflows.name: Bulk Edit and Save Certifications
steps: Load certifications based on filtering parameters (CohortID, CertificationCodeID, etc).
Bind certification data to grid rows for each student.
Allow editing of certification number, effective date, expiry date, status via grid controls.
If actor is System Administrator, expiry date dropdown is visible; otherwise hidden.
On 'Save All' or 'SaveEditNext' command, iterate rows: update dirty rows using StudentDetailsCertificateUpdate service.
Validate input fields: EffectiveDate, ExpiryDate, CertificationNumber, Status.
If errors exist, prevent redirect and display messages.
If successful, redirect to Enrollment or EnrollmentEditAll page with context via query string.
Setup JavaScript for client-side dirty tracking and validation messages.
Hide or show Save/Cancel/EditNext buttons based on read-only state and row count.

workflows.name: Single Certification Update
steps: Edit individual row fields in context of single student certification.
On 'Save' command, call StudentDetailsCertificateUpdate with row data.

business_rules: Only allow expiry date modification if user is System Administrator.
Certification updates are only performed on rows marked 'dirty'.
Redirect only occurs if no error messages are present after update.
Show/hide Save All and Cancel buttons depending on row count and mode.
Hide Save/EditNext buttons in header/footer if fewer than page size rows.
Certification fields are pre-filled from backend for existing certifications.
validations: ExpiryDate must be on or after EffectiveDate.
Status must be selected for each certification row.
conditions: Read-only mode disables calendar, editing, and certain buttons.
If EnrollmentID == 0, bulk edit mode; if > 0, single edit mode.
If certifications exist for student and code, fields are pre-populated.
system_behavior: Loads and binds certification records to grid via ObjectDataSource (dsCRC).
Handles grid commands for saving, editing, navigation.
Controls visibility of UI elements based on context and permissions.
Client-side JavaScript tracks changes and validates fields.
Redirects to enrollment pages based on workflow command and success.
exceptions: Validation failure (dates, number, status) blocks update and redirect.
Errors in StudentDetailsCertificateUpdate result in error messages and prevent navigation.
content_gaps: No explicit field definitions for StudentCertification; inferred from usage.
Underlying implementation of StudentDetailsCertificateUpdate and StudentCertificationSearch not present.
No details on error message formatting and display logic.
Some UI behavior (e.g., button hiding) is referenced but not fully defined.
